swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): Panchayat Samitis can look somewhat different from one State to another. Reason (R): According to the chapter, States have authority over Panchayati Raj institutions, so they are free to organise the structural details differently. Choose the correct option.

add.q: Assertion (A): All three tiers of the Panchayati Raj system reserve one-third of seats for women. Reason (R): The chapter states that the Panchayat Samiti is the topmost of the three tiers, sitting above the Zila Parishad. Choose the correct option.
add.a: A is true, R is false
o: A is true, R is false
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is false, R is true
